北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，微风送爽，体感舒适，记得补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and breezy, feels pleasant. Remember to hydrate!

慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪大雨，湿度高。出门备好雨具，注意安全！

慈溪.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels hot with high humidity. Stay hydrated and use sunscreen.

广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and windy with high humidity. Stay cool and comfortable.
